scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have to got a job to complete the event.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
抱歉，要先轉職才能完成這個活動。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have already completed the event.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
抱歉，你已經完成過這個活動了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Greetings fellow lively human.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
你好，活生生的人類朋友。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Halloween is upon us and it is almost time to adventure out into places few dare go.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
萬聖節就要到了，是時候去那些鮮有人敢涉足的地方冒險了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Trick or treat, which do you prefer?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
惡作劇還是禮物，你選哪一個？

scripts.text: Trick
scripts.translation: 惡作劇

scripts.text: Treat
scripts.translation: 禮物

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a trick. Why don't you go pick a treat now.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
你已經體驗過惡作劇了，現在選份禮物吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Give me a min...
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
請稍等...

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Here is your treat. Your Base EXP has been slightly increased.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
這是你的禮物，基本經驗值增加了一點。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I hope you enjoy your trick and Happy Halloween!
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
希望你喜歡這場惡作劇，萬聖節快樂！

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a treat. Why don't you go pick a trick now.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
你已經領過禮物了，現在試試惡作劇吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Great! This shall be so much fun.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
太好了！這會非常有趣。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Did you get the items I requested or do you need to see the list again?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
我要的物品拿到了嗎？
還是想再看一遍清單？

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I will be sending you on a scavenger hunt for items.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
我要讓你去找一些物品。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Bring back all the necessary items, and I will create you a treat.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
把材料帶齊，我就為你製作一份禮物。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Not just any normal treat either that you can eat, but it is something you can wear on your head.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
可不是普通的糖果，而是能戴在頭上的東西。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
But with all things made, some items are required first.
The list:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
不過，製作東西總得先備好材料。
清單如下：
1 頂帽子，
30 個南瓜，
20 個黑色布料。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Hurry along now.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
快去吧。

scripts.text: Got'em
scripts.translation: 拿到了

scripts.text: Don't Have
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text: See List
scripts.translation: 檢視清單

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
You don't have enough items. Come back when you do.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
材料還不夠，收集齊再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Good job! I hope you are happy with your item.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
幹得好！希望你喜歡這份禮物。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Enjoy the rest of your Halloween.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
繼續享受萬聖節吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Go back out and search for them. Would you like to view the list?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
再出去找找吧。
要看看清單嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I require the following items:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖夜活動]
需要以下材料：
1 頂帽子，
30 個南瓜，
20 個黑色布料。
